runtime.max_total_tokens_selection_rule: 16384 is the sole candidate and is frozen only because the pinned Qwen tokenizer gives calibration pressure 4.150390625 cache budgets, evaluation pressure 8.1455078125 to 8.3271484375 budgets, and a 0.254150390625-cap hot set; abort rather than retune if the GPU capacity gate fails
runtime.cache_topology_acceptance: every fresh startup log must prove impl=RadixCache hybrid_swa=False
runtime.cache_topology_rationale: The pinned Qwen2.5-32B model has no sliding-window layers, and the same pinned image previously served it successfully with ordinary RadixCache. LRU and LFU therefore differ only by the predeclared retention flag, not by cache topology.

physical_eviction_metric_registration.launch_gate: require the metrics endpoint plus kv_evictable_tokens; the physical-eviction counter and histogram do not register until the first real eviction
physical_eviction_metric_registration.non_measured_primer: on every fresh server launch, replay frozen calibration one-off prompts only until a real physical eviction registers both metric definitions and emitted samples; retain a receipt, flush cache, and reset native action counters before any measured or resumed cell
physical_eviction_metric_registration.actual_sample_rule: every measured before and after snapshot must contain both registered definitions and actually emitted evicted-token and eviction-count samples; runner-synthesized zero samples do not qualify
physical_eviction_metric_registration.delta_rule: all cell deltas subtract actually emitted monotonic samples captured after the excluded primer; calibration, smoke, and evaluation begin from a flushed cache with reset native action counters

frequency_aware_baseline.request: LFU or another frequency-aware retention baseline, if feasible
frequency_aware_baseline.failure_disposition: abort the entire extension without deleting, substituting, or retuning the LFU arm

calibration.candidate_disposition: accept the sole 16384-token candidate or abort; do not substitute another cap

arm_order_design.method: five cyclic rows forming a complete 5x5 Latin square
arm_order_design.balance_statement: Each seed contains every arm exactly once, and across five seeds every arm executes exactly once in each chronological position. The controller must execute TSV row order and may not group cells by retention.

workload.pressure_requirement: one-off prompt tokens admitted by native admit-all exceed four times max_total_tokens in calibration and every evaluation trace
workload.hot_set_requirement: combined hot prefixes consume no more than half max_total_tokens
workload.useful_hot_hit_rule: cached_tokens must be at least 1041, the pinned Qwen tokenizer token count of the full family shared_prefix_text; page_size is frozen to 1

freeze_rule: write and verify the excluded LFU feasibility receipt, then calibration_receipt.json and evaluation_freeze.json before the first measured smoke or evaluation request; evaluation_freeze hash is immutable thereafter
